fast.desc: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct Q4_K_M - fast general chat

vision.desc: Gemma 3 4B IT Q4_K_M + mmproj - lightweight vision. ctx raised 8192->24000 with q4_0 KV quantization (2026-10-03, verified live on a 12GB RTX 3060 with ~4.8GB free: a real /v1/chat/completions request succeeded with the real mmproj loaded and ~1.1GB of VRAM margin remaining). Chosen more conservatively than the 'small' profile's 55000 because this is a different model+mmproj combination that was not pushed to its own bleeding edge - override per-host via LLMCTL_CTX_VISION / LLMCTL_KVTYPE_VISION if more is actually available.

vision-pro.desc: Gemma 3 12B IT Q4_K_M + mmproj - higher quality vision

small.desc: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct Q4_K_M - tiny, always-on capable. ctx raised 8192->55000 with q4_0 KV quantization (2026-10-03, verified live on a 12GB RTX 3060 with ~4.8GB free: a real /v1/chat/completions request succeeded at 55000 tokens with ~800 MiB of VRAM margin remaining, and separately at 75000 tokens with only ~170 MiB margin - 55000 was chosen over the higher figure to leave real headroom on a contended host rather than sit at the bleeding edge). Override per-host via LLMCTL_CTX_SMALL / LLMCTL_KVTYPE_SMALL if more or less VRAM is actually available.

decide-nli.desc: DeBERTa-v3-large zeroshot NLI (onnx/model.onnx, fp32, opset 12) - encoder-class typed-decision model served by the onnx engine (lib/onnx_server.py), MIT license. Decisions are computed as NLI entailment: premise = state, one hypothesis per option, ONE ENCODER FORWARD PASS PER OPTION (the cost model - latency grows linearly with option count, hence ctx 512 / parallel 1). CPU-only inference; RAM reservation = model size * 1.5 + 512 MiB. sha256/size re-verified against huggingface.co on 2026-10-07 (specs/009-jev-decision-models/evidence/pin-reverify.json); hf_revision pinned to commit cf44676c. config.json/tokenizer_config.json are small non-LFS git blobs whose sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes and pinned (config.json determines the label order); the unused 8.6 MB tokenizer.json is no longer downloaded (the runner uses spm.model). Override: LLMCTL_PORT_DECIDE_NLI.

benchmark.value: no accuracy figure recorded; zeroshot-NLI capability claim is the upstream model card's task family only

decision.tier_note: experimental choice/score: one encoder forward pass per option (latency grows linearly with option count)

decide-julia.desc: Julia 1 Q8_0 (144M, modern-bert, mmBERT-small base) - tiny non-autoregressive typed-decision encoder served by llama-server's NATIVE /v1/systemone (decision_type laya; needs llama.cpp >= b11379, see docs/decision-models.md). CPU-friendly; min_tier below-minimum only recommends, never blocks. Per-slot context 1024 tokens and defaults.overhead_mb 1160: measured, not estimated - an encoder-class model allocates activation buffers that scale with the state length and the window (peak RSS 1.4 GiB with a state filling the 1024-token window; weights alone are far smaller; specs/009-jev-decision-models/evidence/live/ctx-peak-memory-experiment.txt). A state longer than the window is answered 422. Pins (size, sha256, revision 16fee179) from evidence/admission/ggml-org__Julia-1-GGUF.json, re-verified against huggingface.co in evidence/pin-reverify.json. Override: LLMCTL_PORT_DECIDE_JULIA, LLMCTL_CTX_DECIDE_JULIA.

benchmark.value: 73.15% (1,463/2,000) on typed decisions, H200 BF16, per the upstream model card (vendor-measured, not reproduced; the Q8_0 GGUF was not the measured artifact)
